qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md ('A negative needs a successful control')
evidence: Global rule: tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:17 'Every refusal leg needs its own positive control: a successful action of the same kind, observed in this session.' and :25 requires every role replay to be a legal fresh request with 'the same fresh request as Rafael afterwards (or before, on another card) as its control', and says refusals for duplicate/skip/full stage or stale version do not count as the role refusal. Every functional prompt gate (:15-17) and polish/visual gates require a real UI add + reload + independent-context readback, so a blank/static app gets 0 everywhere. Per-criterion pairing (tests/scored/functional/judge.toml): hro_intake_restart (L31) blank title/places 0,51,2.5/Recruiter-as-manager refusals paired with J1/J2 opening with entered values; invalid and case-variant email refusals paired with 'the same address on J2 is accepted'; 'seeded jobs appear once' paired with recorded-before-restart reads. hro_moves (L40) skip refusals paired with every one-stage move; blank reason vs reason accepted; wrong-stage reopen refusals vs correct reopen; Hired-reject refusal vs earlier rejections. hro_two_people (L49) 409 'The original move is the control' plus Mei's move must succeed. hro_interview_places (L58) full-Interview refusal 'A and B entering Interview are the control'; overfill undo refused then 'the same undo goes ahead'. hro_bulk (L67) refused sets 'steps 3, 6 and 9 are the control'. hro_undo_activity (L76) refused undos paired with successful undos in steps 1, 3 and 5; 'refused attempts added no line' paired with a line for every successful action. hro_manager_roles (L85) 'Rafael's identical requests are the control'; Bill's refusals 'Ingrid's move is the control'. hro_readonly_roles (L94) explicit session controls and same-kind Rafael controls, kinds without a successful control are excluded, 'if no kind has a successful control, this criterion is 0'. hro_messaging (L103) blank refused vs sent two-line message; Ingrid/Aud/Noor refusals vs 'Rafael's own read and send are the controls', Mei/Bill write. hro_long_thread (L112) 'does not move his place' conjoined with 'told there is one new message' within 15 s. hro_unread_seen (L121) 'does not raise' vs earlier rise by exactly two; 'still not seen after only the Observer' vs seen after Tomas opens. hro_candidate (L130) no-leak legs conjoined with 'A candidate page that receives none of its own data makes this criterion 0', status wording through each stage (proves the rejection with the searched suffix happened), notes replay refused 'while Rafael's identical read succeeded', own-conversation read vs other app 404. Polish (tests/scored/polish/judge.toml): live_board/live_thread preservation legs require the update to arrive ('If no update arrives within 60 seconds ... this row is 0'); earlier_place requires 'the earlier ones above it'; failed_send 'nothing was sent' vs 'send again: it is sent once'; session_resume 'nothing was sent' vs reply sends after sign-in ('the positive control'), Mei sees empty boxes vs Rafael's drafts still there. Gates: render judge.toml L25 wrong password paired with correct sign-in, render prompt.md:9 'A valid sign-in immediately after the invalid attempt is the required positive control'; constraints gate is all-positive. Visual is Likert craft, no negative legs. Timed negatives (functional prompt.md:29) watch the forbidden change for 15 s and are always conjoined in their criteria with a positive live arrival. Broken-app attempt: an app whose server refuses every write (or a login-only shell) fails all functional gates and each refusal criterion via its own required control; a dead live channel fails 'does not move his place' because the notice must appear. Conforming-alternative attempt: an app that hides disallowed actions is covered ('not offered ... and replay' / 'Whether a refused action is offered at all is the app's choice'), so it is not failed for absence of a button. Colderwater lessons checked for this row: lesson 16 (no double grading) honored by 'scored elsewhere' language in long_thread/pol rows; lesson 9 (report every step, skipped step fails) at functional prompt.md:31-33 prevents a judge crediting a refusal without running its control. Residual (P3 observation, not a defect): functional prompt.md:21 lets legs blocked by another criterion's broken feature be 'left out', and only hro_readonly_roles states explicitly that a criterion with no surviving control is 0; elsewhere the control legs are themselves named bar legs (e.g. 'A and B entering Interview are the control') and :17 requires an observed control, so a leave-out cannot credit a refusal alone. Source-level review only; no configured judge run, Oracle or model score exists (raw-evidence-index scope says so), and this row does not depend on one.
